headline: President Obama assigned certain duties under a 2015 trade law to other officials in the federal government.
what_it_does: This order hands off some powers and tasks that the Trade Preferences Extension Act of 2015 gave to the President. Those duties go to other federal officials or agencies so they can carry them out. The title does not say which officials or which specific tasks are involved.

who_it_affects.how: They receive authority to carry out certain parts of the 2015 trade preferences law on the President's behalf.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 26, 2016; the effective date is not stated in the title.
